Title: The Sleeping Mind Question for LSJ

Messages.Author: bryan nelson
Messages.Body:
From the Sabbatt expansion. My question is: Has there been any rules
changes to this card? I ask because when I play it on the guy who
constantly has a "Wake with the evenings freshness", I want to be sure
that the card is played as read. Thanks

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


From the Rulings list:

Sleeping Mind [SAB] - Action Modifier (dom) (1)

* Cards played after Sleeping Mind are still free to break these rules,
as always. So while you are prevented from untapping (with Rat's
Warning), for instance, you are not prevented from playing Forced
Awakening/Wake with Evening's Freshness to block - since Wakes allows
you to attempt to block "as if untapped", and untapped vampires can
still block the action as normal. [RTR 980707]
